items.name: Vesugen
items.benefits: The sources describe Vesugen (Lys-Glu-Asp / KED) as a vascular bioregulator and propose effects on endothelial gene expression. They also make claims about blood pressure and other cardiovascular effects, but these sources do not establish efficacy or safety in people. Dosage Peptide characterizes the underlying evidence as mostly cell-culture research and small, non-randomized reports from one research lineage, with benefits unproven.

protocols.title: Vesugen — MyPeptideMatch source 10-day course
protocols.population: Unspecified; the source describes this as educational information and recommends provider review.
protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary editorial source. The page gives a 10-day protocol and a maintenance schedule but supplies no study-level evidence that these doses are safe or effective in people. Its reconstitution details conflict: the quickstart specifies 10 mL bacteriostatic water for a 20 mg vial, while the supplies list says 2 mL. The 10 mL volume matches the stated 2 mg/mL concentration; the discrepancy remains unresolved.

schedule.description: Every other day; the source does not state a maintenance duration.

storage.notes: The source reports storing lyophilized material below 25 °C. It says to refrigerate reconstituted solution at 2–8 °C and use within 28 days.

protocols.title: Vesugen — Dosage Peptide source daily titration (unverified)
protocols.population: Unspecified; source describes this as research and educational information, not human dosing guidance.
protocols.evidenceNotes: Commercial secondary source. Its daily dose schedule (500–2,000 mcg) differs substantially from MyPeptideMatch's 200 mcg 10-day course and 200 mcg every-other-day maintenance alternative. The source schedules are retained separately; neither establishes a safe or effective human regimen.

optional_extension.notes: The source says some references extend the course to about 16 weeks; it does not give a separate titration schedule for that extension.

storage.notes: The source reports storing lyophilized vials at −20 °C (−4 °F). It says to refrigerate reconstituted solution at 2–8 °C, protect it from light, and do not freeze it.
